blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video subtitle removal (VSR) is an important video restoration task, yet existing evaluation remains limited by low-resolution datasets, fragmented test sets, and generic video-inpainting protocols that fail to adequately capture localized restoration errors, unintended modifications, temporal instability, and incomplete outputs. In this paper, we introduce MFVSR, a large-scale multi-style benchmark for fine-grained and reliability-aware video subtitle removal evaluation. MFVSR distinguishes itself through three key features: (1) Large-scale and diverse data, comprising 3,000 paired videos from Real-HQ, Real-LQ, and AI-Generated sources, with an auxiliary set of 953 in-the-wild real videos for real-world coverage analysis; (2) Controlled subtitle diversity, spanning 16 languages and four factors covering spatial layout, temporal behavior, visual style, and language mode; (3) Fine-grained evaluation, introducing an information-conditioned, spatially decoupled protocol that separates blind from mask-guided removal and measures Restoration Fidelity, Preservation Fidelity, Temporal Fidelity, coverage, and failures. Experiments on six representative methods reveal substantial discrepancies between local restoration, outside-region preservation, temporal consistency, and full-set reliability that are obscured by conventional full-frame metrics. MFVSR therefore provides a more comprehensive and diagnostic foundation for evaluating and advancing video subtitle removal methods.
blocks.zh: 视频字幕去除(VSR)是一项重要的视频修复任务,但现有的评价仍然受到低分辨率数据集,零散的测试集,以及无法充分捕捉出局部恢复错误,出乎意料的修改,时间不稳定,以及输出不完整的通用视频插图协议等的限制. 在本文中,我们引入了MFVSR,这是一个用于精细和有可靠性意识的视频字幕删除评价的大规模多风格基准. MFVSR通过三个关键特征来区分自身: (1)大型多姿多彩的数据,由来自Real-HQ,Real-LQ,和AI-Generated的3000对相配视频组成,辅以953个"活泼"真实视频,用于真实世界覆盖分析; (2)可控字幕多样性,跨越16种语言,并涉及空间布局,时间行为,视觉风格,语言模式等4个因素; (3)精细评价,采用信息条件化,空间分解协议,将盲目取出和措施"还原","保真","保真","保真","保真","保真","保真","保真"等,以及失败. 关于六种代表性方法的实验表明,当地恢复、区域外保护、时间一致性和全套可靠性之间存在巨大差异,而传统的全方位衡量标准却掩盖了这些差异。 因此,MFVSR为评估和推进视频字幕删除方法提供了更全面和诊断的基础.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video Subtitle Removal (VSR) aims to remove burned-in subtitles while reconstructing the occluded background and preserving the original visual content ( Kim et al., 2019 ; Xu et al., 2021 ) . Although closely related to video inpainting and scene text removal ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Ding et al., 2025 ; Peng et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) , VSR presents a distinct combination of challenges: subtitle regions must be accurately localized, covered scene content must be faithfully restored, unaffected regions should remain unchanged, and the reconstructed video must remain temporally consistent across frames. These challenges are further complicated by variations in subtitle layout, visual style, language, resolution, and temporal behavior. Consequently, a comprehensive evaluation of existing methods is essential for understanding their capabilities and limitations and for supporting reliable progress in VSR.
blocks.zh: 视频字幕删除(VSR)旨在在重建奥秘背景和保留原始视觉内容的同时删除已烧毁的字幕(Kim等人,2019年;徐等人,2021年). 虽然与视频插图和场景文字清除密切相关(张等,2024年;丁等,2025年;彭等,2024年;王等,2024年),但VSR呈现出不同的挑战组合:字幕区域必须准确定位,覆盖的场景内容必须忠实恢复,未受影响的区域应保持不变,重建后的视频必须保持跨帧时间一致性. 这些挑战由于字幕布局,视觉风格,语言,分辨率,以及时间行为等不同而变得更加复杂. 因此,对现有方法进行全面评估对于了解其能力和局限性以及支持在自愿社会责任方面取得可靠进展至关重要。

blocks.en: However, existing public resources remain insufficient for such systematic VSR evaluation, presenting three core limitations: (L1) Fragmented benchmark coverage. ChaLearn ( ChaLearn Looking at People, 2018 ; Kim et al., 2019 ) is limited to short 128 × 128 128\times 128 clips, while recent methods such as SEDiT ( Hui and Bai, 2026 ) and CLEAR ( He et al., 2026 ) rely on independently constructed paper-specific test sets. As a result, current evaluations cover only a narrow range of video sources, resolutions, and real-world content distributions, making broad and reproducible comparison difficult. (L2) Insufficiently structured subtitle variation. Existing test sets include diverse subtitle appearances, but these variations are rarely organized along explicit and independently controlled factors such as spatial layout, temporal behavior, visual style, and language. This makes it difficult to attribute performance differences to specific subtitle conditions or to conduct systematic stratified analysis. (L3) Generic Benchmarks Lack Subtitle-Specific Evaluation Design. Broader video-inpainting evaluation resources and benchmarks ( Perazzi et al., 2016 ; Xu et al., 2018 ; Chang et al., 2019 ; Szeto and Corso, 2022 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Miao et al., 2025 ) improve content diversity, motion coverage, temporal evaluation, and restoration diagnosis, but are not designed around multilingual subtitle structure, the information asymmetry between blind localization and mask-guided restoration, or spatially decoupled diagnosis with explicit coverage and failure accounting. The core gap is therefore not merely a lack of data, but the absence of a unified benchmark that combines high-resolution paired supervision, controlled subtitle diversity, complementary real-world subtitle coverage, and information-conditioned, spatially decoupled evaluation.
blocks.zh: 然而,现有的公共资源仍然不足以进行这种系统性的VSR评价,这提出了三个核心限制:(L1) 基准覆盖面分散。 ChaLearn (ChaLearn Looking at People, 2018; Kim 等人, 2019) 限短128×128x128\times 128片片段,而SEDIT(Hui and Bai, 2026)和CLEAR(He等人, 2026)等近期方法则依赖于独立构建的纸质专用测试集. 因此,目前的评价只涵盖范围狭窄的视频来源、决议和现实世界内容的分发,因此难以进行广泛和可复制的比较。 (L2) 字幕结构变化不够。 现有的测试集包括了多样的字幕外观,但这些变化很少按照明确和独立控制的因素组织,如空间布局,时间行为,视觉风格,以及语言. 这使得将性能差异归因于特定的字幕条件或进行系统分层分析变得困难. (L3)通用基准缺乏字幕-特定评价设计. 拓宽视频插图评价资源和基准(Perazzi等人,2016年;徐等人,2018年;Chan等人,2019年;Szeto和Corso,2022年;Wu等人,2025年;Miao等人,2025年) 改善内容多样性,运动覆盖度,时间评价和恢复诊断,但并非围绕多语种字幕结构,盲目局部化与面具引导修复之间的信息不对称设计,或者在空间上解析诊断,明确覆盖和故障核算. 因此,核心差距不仅仅是缺乏数据,而且缺乏一个统一基准,将高分辨率对称监督、控制字幕多样性、互补的现实世界字幕覆盖以及信息条件化、空间脱钩的评价结合起来。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of MFVSR. MFVSR contains 3,000 paired videos from Real-HQ, Real-LQ, and AI-generated sources, together with 953 auxiliary in-the-wild videos. It spans 16 languages and four subtitle factors, and evaluates blind and mask-guided removal through five spatial views and three complementary dimensions: Restoration Fidelity, Preservation Fidelity, and Temporal Fidelity.
blocks.zh: 图1:MFVSR概览. MFVSR包含来自Real-HQ,Real-LQ的3000对视频,以及AI生成的源,还有953个辅助的Win-the-wild视频. 它涵盖16种语言和4个字幕因素,通过5个空间观点和3个互补维度来评价盲目和蒙面引导的清除:恢复Fidelity,保护Fidelity,以及TemporalFidelity.

blocks.en:
To directly address these limitations, we propose MFVSR , a Multi-style and Fine-grained benchmark for Video Subtitle Removal, as shown in Figure 1 . MFVSR is built around three key contributions: (1) Large-scale and diverse data. MFVSR contains 3,000 resolution-diverse paired videos, balanced equally across the Real-HQ, Real-LQ, and AI-Generated source strata. Controlled subtitle rendering provides paired clean targets, pixel-level glyph masks, frame-level BBoxes, BBox-derived model-input masks, and rendering
metadata, enabling fine-grained evaluation against known clean content. In addition, we curate an
auxiliary set of 953 naturally subtitled in-the-wild real videos from Bilibili, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Kuaishou, and YouTube to broaden coverage of real-world subtitle appearances and content
distributions. (2) Controlled subtitle diversity. MFVSR covers 16 languages and factorizes subtitle rendering into four independently configurable factors: Spatial Layout, Temporal Behavior, Visual Style, and Language Mode, yielding 24 configuration cells. This controlled design facilitates standardized cross-method comparison and stratified analysis, without presupposing that any language or rendering factor is inherently more challenging. (3) Fine-grained evaluation. MFVSR separates blind subtitle removal from mask-guided removal. Predictions are evaluated using five spatial views and grouped into Restoration Fidelity, Preservation Fidelity, and Temporal Fidelity. It also jointly reports conditional quality, spatial and temporal coverage, partial outputs, and full-benchmark failures.
blocks.zh:
为了直接解决这些限制,我们提议采用MFVSR,这是图1所示的删除视频字幕的多风格和精细基准。 MFVSR围绕三大贡献: (1) 大规模和多样的数据。 MFVSR包含3000个分辨率分散的配对视频,在Real-HQ,Real-LQ,以及AI-Gened源片层之间均匀均衡. 受控字幕渲染提供配对的清洁目标,像素级格莱弗口罩,帧级BBoxes,BBox衍生的模型输入口罩,以及渲染
元数据,能够对已知的清洁内容进行精细评价。 此外,我们管理一个
来自Bilibili、Douyin、Xiaohongshu、Kuaishou和YouTube的953个自然字幕组,
分发。 (2)受控字幕多样性. MFVSR涵盖16种语言,并将字幕渲染成四个独立的可配置因素:空间布局,Temperal行为,视觉风格,和语言模式,生成24个配置单元格. 这种控制设计有利于标准化的跨方法比较和分层分析,而不会预先假定任何语言或渲染因子在本质上更具挑战性. (3)精细评价. MFVSR将盲字幕去除与口罩制导去除分离. 预测利用五种空间观点加以评价,并分为恢复Fieldity、保护Fieldity和临时Fieldity。 它还联合报告有条件的质量、空间和时间覆盖面、部分产出和全部基准故障。

blocks.en:
We evaluate six representative subtitle-removal, video-inpainting, and object-removal methods under MFVSR.
The results reveal distinct trade-offs across restoration, preservation, temporal fidelity, and reliability that conventional full-frame similarity does not capture.
Held-out human comparisons provide stronger support for the spatial components than for the temporal component, and do not establish an advantage of SR-Q over conventional Overall metrics.
MFVSR thus provides a more diagnostic basis for comparing VSR systems.
Benchmark resources will be made publicly available to support reproducible research and future VSR development.
blocks.zh:
我们在MFVSR下评价了六种具有代表性的副标题清除、录像涂装和物体清除方法。
结果表明,在恢复、保存、时间忠贞和可靠性之间有明显的取舍,而传统的全框架相似性并不反映这一点。
被搁置的人类比较为空间组成部分提供了比时间组成部分更强大的支持,并没有确立SR-Q相对于常规总体度量的优势.
因此,MFVSR为比较VSR系统提供了更强的诊断基础.
将公开提供基准资源,以支持可复制的研究和今后的VSR开发。

blocks.en: 2 MFVSR Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 2 MFVSR 基准建设

blocks.en: 2.1 Multi-Source Collection and Base-Video Filtering
blocks.zh: 2.1 多来源收集和底片录像过滤

blocks.en: Multi-source collection for MFVSR. To cover different content origins, resolutions, durations, scenes, and motion patterns, MFVSR contains 3,000 clean base videos from real and generated sources. We divide them into three equal strata. Real-HQ contains 1,000 real videos from OpenVidHD and Pexels ( Nan et al., 2025 ; Pexels, 2026 ) , with retained resolution at or above 1080p. Real-LQ contains 1,000 real videos from Panda-70M and Pexels ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Pexels, 2026 ) , with retained resolution at or above 512p and below 1080p. AI-Generated contains 1,000 videos from the VBench-2.0 sampled-video release ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) and the Rapidata Sora video-generation alignment dataset ( Rapidata, 2025 ) . Real-HQ and Real-LQ are resolution-based strata rather than perceptual-quality labels, and the three sources do not imply exhaustive content coverage.
blocks.zh: MFVSR的多源收藏. 为了覆盖不同内容的起源,分辨率,持续时间,场景,以及运动模式,MFVSR包含了3000个来自真实和生成源的清洁基片. 我们把他们分成三个平等的阶层。 Real-HQ包含来自OpenVidHD和Pexels的1000个真实视频(Nan等人,2025年;Pexels,2026年),保留分辨率在1080p或以上. Real-LQ包含来自Panda-70M和Pexels(Chen等人,2024年;Pexels,2026年)的1000个真实视频,其分辨率保留在512p以上和1080p以下. AI-Generated包含来自V Bench-2.0采样视频发布(郑等人,2025年)和Rapidata Sora视频生成对齐数据集(Rapidata,2025年)的1000个视频. Real-HQ和Real-LQ都是基于分辨率的层次,而不是感官质量的标签,三个来源并不表示详尽的内容覆盖.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Dataset construction and unified processing of MFVSR consists of: (1) Multi-source collection and filtering to provide a clean video pool (Section 2.1 ); (2) Controllable subtitle rendering to generate diverse subtitled videos with different attributes (Section 2.2 ); (3) Preprocessing to construct paired supervision assets (Section 2.3 ); (4) Execution routing to assign each sample to the corresponding model (Section 2.4 ).
blocks.zh: 图 2: MFVSR的数据集构建和统一处理包括:(1) 多源收集和过滤,以提供一个干净的视频库(第2.1节);(2) 可控字幕渲染,以生成具有不同属性的多种字幕视频(第2.2节);(3) 预处理,以构建配对监督资产(第2.3节);(4) 执行路由,将每个样本分配给相应的模型(第2.4节)。

blocks.en: Automatic and manual filtering. We use automatic screening followed by manual verification. Automatic screening samples frames, checks decoding and basic validity, filters by resolution and preliminary clarity, and uses OCR to flag burned-in text, URLs, and other overlays. Manual verification removes videos with burned-in subtitles, salient watermarks, subtitle-like text overlays, static slideshows, cartoons, anime, or other content unsuitable for paired subtitle rendering. Small logos may remain if they are fixed in a corner and cannot be confused with the rendered subtitles. Large, prominent, textual, or subtitle-region watermarks are excluded. The resulting clean videos enter the rendering pipeline in Figure 2 . Additional asset-validation checks are described in Appendix B.1 .
blocks.zh: 自动和人工过滤。 我们使用自动筛选,然后进行人工核查。 自动筛选样本框架,检查解码和基本有效性,通过分辨率和初步清晰度进行过滤,并使用OCR标出燃烧文本,URL,以及其他覆盖. 人工校验会删除带有燃烧字幕的视频,突出的水印,类似字幕的文本覆盖,静态幻灯片放映,卡通,动画,动画,或者其他内容不适合配对字幕渲染. 如果小的标志固定在一个角落,并且不能与提供的字幕相混淆,那么小的标志可能会留下. 不包括大、突出、文字或字幕区域水印。 产生的清洁视频在图2中进入渲染管道. 附录B.1介绍了其他资产核实检查。

blocks.en: 2.2 Controllable Subtitle Rendering Engine
blocks.zh: 2.2 可控字幕渲染引擎

blocks.en: Text and font resources. Subtitle text is drawn from FLORES-200 ( Costa-Jussà et al., 2022 ; Goyal et al., 2022 ; Guzmán et al., 2019 ) , and fonts are obtained from Google Fonts ( Google Fonts, 2026 ) . MFVSR uses 16 languages: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean for CJK scripts; English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, and Vietnamese for Latin scripts; Russian for Cyrillic; Arabic and Persian for right-to-left scripts; and Hindi and Thai for additional writing systems. These languages introduce different glyph structures, shaping rules, reading directions, and layout characteristics without assuming a language-specific difficulty order. Fonts are divided into regular and style-oriented resources.
blocks.zh: 文字与字体资源. 副标题文本取自FLORES-200(Costa-Jossà等人,2022年;Goyal等人,2022年;Guzmán等人,2019年),字体取自Google Fonts(Google Fonts,2026年). MFVSR使用16种语言:简化汉语,传统汉语,日语,朝鲜语为CJK脚本;英语,西班牙语,法语,德语,葡萄牙语,意大利语和越南语为拉丁字母;俄语为西里尔语;阿拉伯语和波斯语为右转左脚本;印地语和泰语为附加书写系统. 这些语言引入了不同的格律结构,塑造规则,阅读方向,以及布局特征,而不假设语言特有的难度顺序. 字体分为正版和风格导向资源.

blocks.en: Multi-level taxonomy combination rendering. MFVSR structures the taxonomy around the changing aspect of a subtitle over its display interval, spanning four independently configurable axes. The four independently configurable factors form Spatial Layout × Temporal Behavior × Visual Style × Language Mode , \text{Spatial Layout}\times\text{Temporal Behavior}\times\text{Visual Style}\times\text{Language Mode}, which yields 2 × 2 × 3 × 2 = 24 2\times 2\times 3\times 2=24 major configuration cells. And finer-grained subtypes add further within-cell variation, as shown in Figure 3 .
blocks.zh: 多层次分类学组合渲染. MFVSR围绕一个字幕的不断变化的方面,在显示间隔上构建分类,跨越四个独立的可配置轴. 四个独立配置因素构成了空间布局 × 时态行为 × 视觉样式 × 语言模式 ,\ text{空间布局 }\ times\ text{ 临时行为 }\ times\ text{ visual Style\times\text{语言模式},它输出2×2×3×2×2×2×2×24 2×2×2×2×2×2×24主要配置单元格. 如图3所示,细纹亚型会进一步增加细胞内变异.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Controlled subtitle-rendering taxonomy in MFVSR. The two-level ring summarizes four independently configurable factors: Spatial Layout, Temporal Behavior, Visual Style, and Language Mode and their major options, forming 24 configuration cells. Surrounding examples are color-coded by factor to illustrate finer-grained within-cell variations.
blocks.zh: 图3:MFVSR中受控字幕发送分类. 双层环概括了四个独立的可配置因素:空间布局,Temperal行为,视觉风格,以及语言模式及其主要选项,形成24个配置单元格. 环绕的例子按因子进行色码,以说明细胞内部的细纹变化.

blocks.en: Spatial layout governs where a subtitle appears and whether its coordinates change over time: fixed subtitles occupy one of five anchors with constant coordinates, whereas dynamic subtitles follow one of four trajectories, making position a function of time. Temporal behavior captures how a subtitle evolves between appearance and disappearance. Static subtitles remain unchanged while visible, whereas animated subtitles comprise nine subtypes that cover entrance transformations of whole blocks, reveals at the character level, and persistent perturbations. Spatial layout and temporal behavior are orthogonal and may occur together. For example, a caption can translate from point 𝒜 \mathcal{A} to point ℬ \mathcal{B} (spatial, dynamic), while a fade-in or typewriter effect alters its form without displacing it (temporal, animated). Therefore, we retain them as separate axes. Visual style determines how glyphs are rendered, ranging from plain (color variation only), to decorated (shadows, outlines, or background boxes for functional separation), to stylized (glow, gradients, neon, textures, or expressive fonts). Language mode sets how many languages appear simultaneously: monolingual subtitles contain a single language, while bilingual subtitles pair two randomly selected languages, typically arranged in two lines, and configurations with more than two languages are excluded as uncommon in practice.
blocks.zh: 空间布局支配着字幕出现的地方及其坐标是否随时间而变化:固定字幕占据了5个主播之一并具有恒定坐标,而动态字幕则遵循4个轨迹中的一个,使位置成为时间的函数. 暂时的行为捕捉到字幕如何在外表和消失之间演化. 静态字幕在可见时保持不变,而动画字幕则包括9个子类型,涵盖整块的入口变换,在人物层面揭示,以及持续的扰动. 空间布局和时间行为是正交的,可能一起发生. 例如,一个标题可以从 A\ mathcal{A} 点翻译到 B\ mathcal{B} (空间,动态), 而一个淡入或打字机的效果则会改变其形式而不将其取代(时间,动画). 因此,我们保留它们作为单独的轴线。 视觉风格决定了甘油的渲染方式,从平原(只有颜色变异)到装饰(阴影,轮廓,或功能分离的背景框),到结构化(光,梯度,霓虹,纹理,或表达字体). 语言模式设定了多种语言同时出现:单语字幕包含一种语言,而双语字幕则对两个随机选择的语言,一般以两行排列,而拥有两种以上语言的配置在实际操作中被排除为罕见.

blocks.en: The four axes combine to produce 24 major cells. While the factors are independent in configuration, their effects on removal difficulty may not be statistically independent. Therefore, potential mediators like subtitle area and line count are evaluated separately for each factor.
blocks.zh: 四轴结合产生24个主要细胞. 虽然这些因素在配置上是独立的,但它们对清除困难的影响在统计上可能并不独立。 因此,对副标题领域和行数等潜在调解人分别对每个因素进行评价。

blocks.en: 2.3 Preprocessing and Paired-Asset Generation
blocks.zh: 2.3 预处理和Paired-Asset生成

blocks.en: For each clean base, video synthesis yields three aligned outputs: a rendered subtitle video, a pixel-level glyph-mask video, and per-frame BBox JSON. The clean base is retained as ground truth, and the rendering configuration is stored as metadata. The BBox JSON is the canonical rectangular annotation for mask-guided models. From it, we generate two equivalent mask representations: Mask Sequences (frame-wise binary PNG masks) and Mask MP4 (the same sequence losslessly encoded as a video). These formats encode identical spatial and temporal mask information and are not separate ground-truth annotations. The glyph mask is reserved for fine-grained evaluation, whereas the BBox-derived mask is used as model input.

blocks.en:
Methods and fairness. Section 2 constructs each MFVSR instance
by rendering temporally controlled subtitles over a clean base video. Given a clean target 𝐘 \mathbf{Y} , the renderer produces a subtitle-corrupted video 𝐗 \mathbf{X} , glyph mask 𝐆 \mathbf{G} , frame-level BBoxes 𝐁 \mathbf{B} , and identifier-encoded rendering attributes 𝒜 render \mathcal{A}^{\mathrm{render}} : ℐ = ( 𝐗 , 𝐘 , 𝐆 , 𝐁 , 𝒜 render ) . \mathcal{I}=(\mathbf{X},\mathbf{Y},\mathbf{G},\mathbf{B},\mathcal{A}^{\mathrm{render}}). (1) The attributes describe language mode, visual style, spatial layout, temporal behavior, and the stored font, color, decoration, animation, and trajectory parameters. We evaluate one blind method, CLEAR, and five mask-guided methods: ProPainter, DiffuEraser, MiniMax-Remover, OmnimatteZero, and EffectErase. Blind removal receives only 𝐗 \mathbf{X} ; mask-guided removal additionally receives the same canonical BBox-derived mask. The glyph mask is reserved for evaluation and is never exposed as model input. Because the two settings provide different information, they share targets and metrics but remain in separate result blocks. Every method retains its released resolution limit, precision, chunking, sampling, and deterministic mask adapter. Raw outputs are immutable: missing frames are neither copied nor padded, and a metric is withheld when its spatial or temporal correspondence cannot be verified. All model interfaces are frozen in Table 6 .

blocks.en: Spatially decoupled evaluation. As illustrated in Figure 1 , MFVSR evaluates five views: Overall, BBox, Subtitle, BBox-NG, and Outside. Subtitle, BBox-NG, and Outside partition each frame, BBox is the union of the first two, and Overall is the full frame. Because the glyph mask can omit shadows, outlines, glow, or subtitle boxes, BBox-NG mixes nearby background with non-core subtitle effects and is used only as a local diagnostic. Boxed and Subtitle-box styles are analyzed separately because their affected support can extend beyond the text BBox.
blocks.zh: 空间脱钩评价. 如图1所示,MFVSR评价了五种观点: 总体来说,BBox,副标题,BBox-NG,以及Outside. 副标题 BBox-NG 和 Outside分区每个帧 BBox是前两个帧的结合,总体是全帧. 由于glyph面具可以省略阴影,轮廓,发光,或字幕盒,BBox-NG将附近的背景与非核心字幕效果混合,仅用作局部诊断. Boxed和Subtitle-box样式被分别分析,因为其受影响的支持可以延伸到文本BBox之外.

blocks.en: The five views are organized into three capabilities (Table 3 ). Restoration Fidelity asks whether the subtitle core is replaced by the clean target; Preservation Fidelity asks whether content outside the operational BBox remains unchanged; and Temporal Fidelity asks whether the prediction introduces temporal error beyond the target motion. PSNR, SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , DISTS ( Ding et al., 2020 ) , and RAFT ( Teed and Deng, 2020 ) retain their released implementations and weights. Regional PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS change only the aggregation support; conditioned DISTS is explicitly a controlled-input intervention, not an official dense DISTS variant. Overall metrics are retained for conventional full-frame compatibility rather than used as the primary evidence.

Shared-video quality decomposes into non-interchangeable capabilities. The strongest methods differ across Restoration, Preservation, and Temporal fidelity even on the same Audit300 videos.
DiffuEraser favors glyph-core reconstruction, ProPainter Outside preservation and temporal consistency, and MiniMax-Remover Outside TWE-X, while EffectErase achieves favorable conditional values only on its verified prefix.
Thus, gains in one capability do not imply gains in another, and conditional quality must be interpreted together with output support. These results motivate a capability profile rather than a single aggregate ordering.

blocks.en: Subtitle removal performance varies across dataset dimensions and capabilities. Figure 6 shows that source, resolution, duration, and style complexity affect different capabilities in different ways. Real-HQ yields higher Subtitle and Outside LPIPS than AI-generated videos for all six methods, yet lower BBox TC for five, indicating that visually harder restoration does not necessarily imply greater temporal instability. Because source and resolution are coupled in Audit300, this contrast should be interpreted as a property of the joint data strata rather than an isolated resolution effect. Duration and style further reveal method-dependent shifts in error: all five mask-guided methods have higher Subtitle LPIPS on 10–30 s clips, while Hard styles reduce their Subtitle LPIPS but increase Outside LPIPS; CLEAR instead worsens on both. Thus, increasing data complexity can redistribute errors across restoration and preservation rather than degrade all capabilities uniformly, motivating capability-wise evaluation over a single aggregate score. Further analyses are provided in Appendix C.3 .

Evaluable scope and conditional quality require separate interpretation. Table 13 and
Figure 12 show that extending evaluation
from the common intersection to each method’s native evaluable set changes
both the assessed scope and the observed quality distribution.
These changes are method- and metric-dependent: typical and tail errors can
shift differently, while spatial and temporal quality can even move in
opposite directions.
Thus, broader evaluability should not be interpreted as uniformly easier or
harder data, nor should conditional quality be used as a proxy for operating
scope.
Native evaluation instead complements shared-ID comparisons by revealing
performance on videos excluded from the common intersection, while comparisons
across different native sets do not constitute controlled cross-method
rankings.
Further analysis is provided in

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we presented MFVSR , a benchmark for systematic evaluation of video subtitle removal. MFVSR combines paired videos with controlled multilingual subtitle variations and an auxiliary collection of naturally subtitled videos. Its protocol distinguishes blind from mask-guided removal and separately evaluates restoration, preservation, temporal fidelity, and delivery coverage. Experiments on six representative methods reveal quality trade-offs and gaps between conditional performance and complete-video delivery. The held-out human study shows stronger agreement for spatial than temporal components, leaving temporal perceptual validation open. We hope that MFVSR and its analyses support reproducible comparison and the development of more reliable video subtitle removal methods.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了MFVSR,这是系统评价删除视频字幕的基准。 MFVSR将配对的视频与受控的多语种字幕变体和天然字幕视频的辅助集结合起来. 其协议将盲目清除与蒙面制导清除区分开来,并分别评价修复、保存、时间忠贞和交付覆盖。 关于六种代表性方法的实验揭示了质量权衡和有条件的性能与完整视频交付之间的差距。 被搁置的人类研究表明,空间成分比时间成分更一致,使时间感知验证开放。 我们希望MFVSR及其分析能够支持可复制的比较和开发更可靠的视频字幕删除方法.

blocks.en:
Video Subtitle Removal. Video subtitle removal combines localization, completion, and temporal
stabilization. The ChaLearn 2018 video-decaptioning task ( ChaLearn Looking at People, 2018 ) provided paired corrupted and clean clips,
while Kim et al. (2019) introduced a blind encoder–decoder that
aggregates neighboring frames with recurrent feedback without requiring an
input mask. Recent diffusion-based methods revisit end-to-end mask-free
removal at higher resolution. CLEAR ( He et al., 2026 ) separates
subtitle-prior extraction from generative refinement and performs mask-free
inference, whereas SEDiT ( Hui and Bai, 2026 ) formulates subtitle erasure as
localized one-step video generation with chunk-wise streaming. These methods
strengthen the case for a dedicated task, but their paper-specific
400-sample evaluations do not provide a shared, fine-grained protocol for
diagnosing residual text, local reconstruction, distant modification, and
failure coverage.
The distinction between mask-free and mask-guided inference is methodological
rather than cosmetic. A blind method must infer both where and how to edit,
whereas a mask-guided method is given spatial side information. Combining both
settings in one ranking conflates localization and restoration. MFVSR
therefore uses the same paired targets and diagnostic views for both settings
but reports them in separate leaderboard blocks.

Video Inpainting and Object Removal. Most video-inpainting methods assume a binary hole mask and focus on
reconstructing spatially plausible and temporally coherent content.
Flow-guided methods such as E2FGVI ( Li et al., 2022 ) propagate visible
evidence across frames, while later transformer- and diffusion-based
approaches expand temporal context and generative capacity.
ProPainter ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) combines dual-domain propagation with a
mask-guided sparse video transformer, while
DiffuEraser ( Li et al., 2025 ) incorporates diffusion priors for masked
video completion. Recent video-object-removal systems further target large
objects and associated visual effects. MiniMax-Remover ( Zi et al., 2026 ) reduces sampling cost through a distilled removal model;
OmnimatteZero ( Samuel et al., 2025 ) uses pretrained video diffusion
models to remove objects together with their footprints; and
EffectErase ( Fu et al., 2026 ) jointly learns removal and insertion to
better handle shadows, reflections, and deformation.
These methods are relevant baselines because the same canonical BBox-derived
subtitle annotation can be deterministically adapted to their released
interfaces. They are not subtitle localizers, however, and their mask-guided
results are not presented as evidence of blind subtitle-removal ability.

and R3’s transparent glass expose further reconstruction errors. Removing

blocks.en:
Spatial errors and temporal changes can occur together, making
an overall visual preference difficult to interpret. The separate
Restoration and Temporal tasks help distinguish these judgments, though the
high undecided rate in the held-out temporal study limits conclusions about
metric alignment (Appendix C.6 ).
blocks.zh:
空间错误和时间变化可以一起发生,
总的视觉偏好 很难解释。 单独的
恢复和临时任务有助于区分这些判决,尽管
暂停时间研究的高未决定率限制了关于
度量校正(附录C.6)。

blocks.en:
Three-frame strips locate transitions for inspection; they cannot establish
perceptible flicker over a full video. That assessment requires playback on
shared support, as provided by the original evaluation interface in
Figure 7 .
